role: Senior BI Developer (Power BI, SQL/PL-SQL) – German- Romania
responsibilities: Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL and PL/SQL queries to support reporting and data analysis requirements.
Analyze, prepare, transform, and model data from various sources.
Design, develop, and maintain interactive reports, dashboards, and KPI analyses using Power BI.
Create and optimize DAX calculations, measures, and business metrics.
Translate business requirements into effective reporting and business intelligence solutions.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify reporting needs and transform data into actionable insights.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reports and dashboards.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data processing, reporting, and performance.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of BI processes, reporting standards, and data visualization practices.
